title: Embedding of a tracked tape triple
statement: For a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$ and one of its work tapes $i$, the embedding of the three roles—data, visited mark, and origin mark—into the work tapes of the prepared source machine sends those roles to their corresponding slots in the three consecutive tape banks.
